selectors.coverage_basis: No cc-db/cc-index exclusion, filter or required feature in the first default execution. Cargo auto-discovers both new/inherited integration files and cfg(test) modules. cc-eval oracle tests repeat under optional eval-http; repeated invocations must retain context, not inflate distinct-control counts.

identity_checks: Fetch the actual final C and parent product/review chain from root before using this plan; verify product and all non-trust validation bytes against P2 and compare this CI workflow exact blob.
Enumerate official workflow runs filtered by exact C, preserve all pages total_count/unique IDs/head/run_attempt/event, never mix E6/C4/275e runs.

CI actions/checkout@v4 defaults to PR test-merge. Read actual checkout from full logs, GET exact merge object parents/tree, and retain actual merge identity. If main changes, compare relevant actual inputs explicitly; never relabel a different full tree as C.
MSRV/security also use default checkout; retain each original actual job identity and actual version/audit result.
Bind executed v15 output to the final PRODUCT/REVIEW/registry pins and full source population; original historical v2/TODO definitions must actually pass without changing the criteria.
acceptance_method: For each of the 16 methods locate an actual nonignored ok result in the expected cargo target/step. Absence, filter-only listing, compilation, failed predecessor or ignored outcome does not count as execution.

Preserve the full check log once at terminal completion, including every failure, ignored and filtered result; aggregate counts as invocation occurrences and do not hardcode old totals or call them unique tests.

Require original formatting, clippy, compile-all-default-targets and all scheduled check steps to conclude successfully; inspect HTTP/status/stdio, historical guard, facts, source integrity, plan/corpus and real MCP steps in their original scopes.
Retain all existing explicit ignored selections; ordinary ignored occurrences remain ignored. Do not introduce new broad test selectors or omit old ones.

MSRV is compile compatibility on Rust1.95.0 for workspace/all-targets and optional eval-http, not a test execution. Security is the actual rustsec audit-check result, with warnings/advisories and failures retained.
New source controls and v15 success are engineering admission, not complete scale/runtime/platform/quality certification or original TODO completion.
